<thought>Using the three measured resistances we can deduce a series chain. Let R1 be between X1 and Nb1 (5 Ω). The total X1‑X2 resistance is 18.333 Ω, so the remaining two resistors sum to 13.333 Ω. The note says one resistor is twice the other, so let R2 = 2·R3. Solving gives R3 = 4.444 Ω and R2 = 8.889 Ω. This satisfies all measurements within rounding error. The topology is therefore a simple series connection X1‑R1‑Nb1‑R2‑Nmid‑R3‑X2.</thought>
